source.title: DPHHS Water Laboratory Certification Program + Montana State Environmental Laboratory Private Well Testing
limitations: DPHHS Water Laboratory Certification Program certifies labs to analyze public drinking-water supplies; private-well acceptance is not stated per commercial/municipal row — marked unknown; call first.
DPHHS Montana State Environmental Laboratory explicitly offers Private Well Testing (Chemistry and Microbiology forms) — verified private-well path.
In-state Montana laboratory locations tabulated from the DPHHS certification page (15 unique locations). Out-of-state certified labs omitted from the table (linked via official page).
Odd spellings kept as printed where they appear on the DPHHS page (e.g. Ravali; Bozeman, Mt on one listing).
Energy Laboratories Helena and Montana Environmental Laboratory appear with both street and PO Box addresses on different roster blocks — both printed forms noted.
Fees intentionally omitted — confirm current fee with DPHHS Environmental Laboratory (fee schedule PDF linked, not republished).
Box curl/Chrome TLS to dphhs.mt.gov failed (unexpected EOF); official content retrieved via WebFetch and archived as dated .txt under data/sources/mt-*.
Kansas KDHE AB Manager remains JS-only without a verified static export — skipped again.

MSU Extension Well Educated / certified-labs pages cited as secondary homeowner context only — no labs invented from Extension; MSU note that Montana Bureau of Mines and Geology does not test homeowner samples is secondary and not used to invent a DPHHS claim.

verified_paths.name: DPHHS Montana State Environmental Laboratory — Private Well Testing (Chemistry)
verified_paths.notes: Official Chemistry Testing for Private Well Sample Submission Form (July 2025 on form; prices subject to change — fees not republished). Hub: Environmental Laboratory page. Lab: P.O. Box 4369 / 1400 Broadway Room B-206, Helena; (406) 444-3444; toll-free (800) 821-7284. Packages named on form include Basic Screen, Metals Screen, Anion Screen, VOC, Pesticides, Herbicides, Full Well Screen. Samples paid in advance; bacteria samples within 48 hours.

verified_paths.name: DPHHS Montana State Environmental Laboratory — Private Well Testing (Microbiology / bacteria-only)
verified_paths.notes: Official Bacteria Testing for Private Well Sample Submission Form (January 2024 on form; prices subject to change — fees not republished). Tests named: Total Coliform P/A, Total Coliform Count, Iron Bacteria, Sulfur Bacteria. Same Helena lab contact/delivery as chemistry form.
